3.speaker: Titus Gordion
3.text: “Actually, there is, in fact, a matter that requires your attention."

4.speaker: Titus Gordion
4.text: Government facilities in a handful of smaller towns have been seized, sparking street riots as citizens demand change. The situation has escalated far beyond calling it mere unrest."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: “Well, then what would you call it?”

7.speaker: Titus Gordion
7.text: “Or at the very least, the makings of one.”

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: “Titus, I think you're blowing this out of proportion.”

9.speaker: Titus Gordion
9.text: “I can assure you, I'm not. We’re seeing a turning point that we can no longer ignore.”

10.speaker: Titus Gordion
10.text: “I've already made arrangements for myself in case this worst-case scenario comes to pass, and advise you to do the same.”

11.speaker: Titus Gordion
11.text: "A storm is coming, Your Majesty. There's no doubt about it. How you prepare for it is up to you."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "Your concern is duly noted, Captain. However, I have weathered many storms in my time as king, and I will not falter now."

16.speaker: Titus Gordion
16.text: "The ongoing protests we've been seeing have taken a significant turn for the worse, escalating across the entire kingdom."

21.speaker: Titus Gordion
21.text: “Actually, there is a matter that may require your attention."

22.speaker: Titus Gordion
22.text: "I've been receiving anonymous tips and warnings from informants within the court and from sources outside the kingdom who speak of growing discontent with the current leadership."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I see... It seems trust is becoming a rare commodity these days. What else can you tell me?"

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "I won't tolerate betrayal from within my own court. Can you tell me who these traitor are? We need to get to the bottom of this treachery."

26.speaker: Titus Gordion
26.text: "Yes, sir. These sources hint at potential changes in leadership, but don't disclose which noble houses are involved."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "'Anonymous sources... unnamed noble houses... Sorry, but I don't take cryptically vague threats very seriously."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "This is troubling news. Continue to gather any and all information that you can, Titus. We must stay vigilant."

29.speaker: Titus Gordion
29.text: "It's a matter not to be taken lightly."

30.speaker: Titus Gordion
30.text: "From what I've gathered, my sources hint at potential changes in leadership, but don't disclose which noble houses are involved."

31.speaker: Titus Gordion
31.text: My informants haven't disclosed the specific noble houses involved -- rather, they've only mentioned a growing discussion about a potential leadership change."

32.speaker: Titus Gordion
32.text: "This may not sound like much, but I can assure you that my informants are reliable, and what they've uncovered shouldn't be taken lightly."

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "Sounds like someone's been reading too many spy thrillers. But in all seriousness, if there's even a hint of truth to these whispers, we must act swiftly."

34.speaker: Titus Gordion
34.text: "Yes, sir. Before I go, I would be remiss if I didn't inform you that I've already made arrangements for myself in case this worst-case scenario comes to pass, and would advise you to do the same."

35.speaker: Titus Gordion
35.text: “I assure you, this threat is very real. We’re seeing a turning point that we can no longer ignore.”

36.speaker: Titus Gordion
36.text: Very well. But before I go, I would be remiss if I didn't inform you that I've already made arrangements for myself in case this worst-case scenario comes to pass, and would advise you to do the same."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "Thanks for the weather report, Titus. I'll make sure to pack an umbrella."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "Thanks, but I didn't ask for unsolicited advice. You're excused, Captain."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "I appreciate your concern, Titus. I'll take it into consideration."

47.speaker: Titus Gordion
47.text: "Funny you should mention it... it just so happens that I took the liberty of inviting Lucita to meet us for that very purpose."

49.speaker: Titus Gordion
49.text: "And, actually, should be arriving any minute--"

50.speaker: Titus Gordion
50.text: "And speaking of unexpected revelations, there's someone here who can hopefully shed some light on the matter."

51.speaker: Titus Gordion
51.text: "Well, if you don't believe me, then maybe you'll believe what Lucita has to say for herself, who I invited here and should be arriving shortly."

53.speaker: Titus Gordion
53.text: "I'm glad you brought that up because that brings up another matter that deserves your immediate attention."

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: "I felt compelled to share with you the findings of our investigation into your uncle and Grand Vizier, Hugo."

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: "It all began with eyewitness accounts, including my own, placing Hugo exiting the late King’s private chambers just before his death."

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: "There's been a lingering conspiracy theory surrounding Hugo, suggesting he sees himself as the rightful king."

57.speaker: Narrator
57.text: "This alone provided a motive for suspicion, not to mention the rumored bitter rivalry between them."

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: "However, as I delved deeper, I uncovered a surprising truth."

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: "Hugo and King Valero shared a close bond, evident through their correspondence and numerous testimonials."

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: "There was no evidence of Hugo aspiring to claim the throne. The supposed rivalry was a mere fiction."

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: "Regarding the night of Valero’s demise, I found no traces linking Hugo to any murder weapon."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: "When the late king was exhumed, a preserved sample of formalin-fixed tissue allowed for an advanced toxicology examination by Iza University's laboratories."

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: "You might be surprised to learn that traces of Mandragora -- a deadly nightshade --were found in the late king's system during a recent toxicology test."

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: "However, despite our exhaustive efforts, there's no evidence linking Hugo to the possession or acquisition of such a poison. It appears to be a case of him being at the wrong place at the wrong time."

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: "I hope this information proves useful to you, Your Majesty, as you continue to seek answers and closure regarding your father's untimely passing."

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: "I must bring to your attention the progress made in our investigation concerning Lucita."

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: "While our efforts yielded significant findings, they only extended as far as the toxicology report."

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: "Initially, suspicions were raised due to the presence of Mandragora—a lethal nightshade—in your father's toxicology report."

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: "However, we were unable to uncover any tangible evidence linking Lucita to the acquisition or possession of such a poison."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: "I felt compelled to share with you the findings of our investigation into your uncle and former Grand Vizier, Hugo."

76.speaker: Narrator
76.text: "Despite our thorough investigation, we were unable to uncover any further leads or evidence implicating Lucita in the matter."

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: "I trust this information sheds some light on the ongoing investigation, and I remain committed to assisting you in any way possible to bring closure to this troubling ordeal."
